pages.text: Goes on the $(thing)left$() of a Coffee Machine, as you face its front. It adds a $(thing)syrup slot$() in the bottom left.

pages.title: Syrups
pages.text: Also optional: one ingredient is used per cup, adding 1 minute of its effect:$(li)$(item)Pufferfish$(): Water Breathing$(li)$(item)Fermented Spider Eye$(): Invisibility$(li)$(item)Golden Carrot$(): Night Vision$(li)$(item)Rabbit's Foot$(): Jump Boost$(br2)A cup can have milk and a syrup.
